output.text: Notes from this morning's incident. Early in the morning the Grafana Alerts started firing for the AP High Gateway. The pods were restarting in a loop, and kubectl showed them being killed for running out of memory. It turned out that the new release of the Helm chart had dropped the memory limit override, so the default limit was far too small. We rolled back with Argo CD, and the service recovered within a few minutes. Follow-ups add a check to the pipeline and compares the rendered manifests, move the alert thresholds into Prometheus rules that live next to the chart, and write a short run-book so whoever is on call next time doesn't have to dig through the history. I'll create the tickets after lunch.
